integrity: The theorem is proved analytically for every admissible cyclic group. The bundled numerical sweep is corroborative only. The original Mockenhaupt 1996 thesis was not directly available; its relevant example is compared only through the specific description in Krenedits 2010. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to normalized ell-one norm, equal-magnitude three-term arithmetic progressions, and nondegenerate quotient order at least three. The certificate bounds are not claimed to be the exact norms for quotient order at least five.
title: Uniform finite-cyclic ell-one majorant reversal for a three-term arithmetic progression
